record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Finished efforts take tab space and Tab presses while holding nothing to do. Keeping those with Needs you items visible means no open finding or sign-off is hidden.

## Counter-argument

Dimmed and sorted last already keeps them out of the way, and hiding them makes a closed-looking effort easy to forget to actually close.

payload.alternatives: keep finished efforts dimmed and sorted last
payload.choice: Finished efforts are hidden behind f with a +N finished marker; a finished effort with Needs you items stays visible

record.subject: finished-effort-toggle
